intent: Convenience base providing the poll()-loop state machine (prePoll/postPoll) shared by every TCP-socket-managing class, plus the Socket and Port value types those managers operate on.

objects.name: STCPManager
objects.role: namespace-like holder of static prePoll/postPoll/openPort; no data members of its own by design

objects.name: STCPManager::Socket
objects.role: per-connection state machine (RESOLVING/CONNECTING/CONNECTED/SHUTTINGDOWN/CLOSED); owns fd, buffers, optional SSL state, async DNS handle

objects.name: STCPManager::Port
objects.role: RAII wrapper for a listening socket fd and its host string

location_fit.note: base class for the STCPNode/SQLiteServer hierarchy documented in class_hierarchy.md

naming_quality.note: in Socket's protected section, methods are `_`-prefixed but sibling protected data members (sendBuffer, sendRecvMutex, https, dnsResolution, hostToResolve, socketCount) are not
